dialogues.speaker: Goldoni
dialogues.text: Fret not about the lies those slaves tell. Their so-called Lochknights are but facetious far-fetched fictions.

dialogues.speaker: Goldoni
dialogues.text: They spread rumors and call those barbarians who worship a false god "knights," believing that they shall one day free them from their fated duties.

dialogues.speaker: Goldoni
dialogues.text: I do not condemn such folly, for folly is the way of the lowly. Yet their delusions are fanned ever hotter, such that their melodies are tranquil no longer.

dialogues.speaker: Goldoni
dialogues.text: They must be cured. Once the disturbances here have subsided, I shall act forcefully to correct such strange skeins of supposition.

dialogues.speaker: Goldoni
dialogues.text: Delusion and weakness both breed turmoil.
